t: The Flomasta 22mm PE-X pipe is a versatile and durable solution for plumbing and heating systems. This white cross-linked polyethylene pipe offers a flexible alternative to traditional copper tubing, making installation easier in tight spaces and around obstacles. It is suitable for a wide range of applications, including domestic hot and cold water supplies and central heating circuits, and is approved for drinking water. Its robust construction ensures reliable performance in both hard and soft water areas, providing a long-lasting and efficient pipework solution for professional plumbers and heating engineers.
